Audience: first-time Minnesota Class D applicants, teens under eighteen and their parents, adults who were never licensed, and newcomers moving in from other states or countries.
Why it matters to a first-timer: this section lays out the never-licensed path of written test, vision test, permit and road test [A01], the refusal reasons [A02], and the written test scoring rule [A05].
Level: rule recall with many look-alike thresholds (ages, permit months, expiry windows, retest fees and vision numbers); moderate load because newcomer, teen and adult paths run side by side.
Prerequisites: the test checklists in the opening new-laws section.
